name: Repo Notebook MCP
description: Local shelf of saved GitHub repositories: list and search, save, annotate, clone, and remove entries. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: Set RN_DATA_DIR to a dedicated folder so the server reads and writes only that notebook and its clones.
Keep save, annotate, remove and clone tools on review; they change the stored notebook or write cloned source code to disk.
Cloning downloads third-party code but never installs or runs it; review the repository before running anything from the clones folder.
Leave GITHUB_TOKEN unset unless you need higher GitHub API rate limits; the server only sends it with GitHub API read requests.
